name: VRDF Texture Construction for Label-Weighted Volumes
definition: A method to construct GPU textures for Unity volume rendering when the input data is in 'anatomy_label_weighted' mode with 2 channels. It separates discrete labels and continuous weights into distinct 3D textures with specific filtering modes to support weighted raymarching.
summary: VRDF Texture Construction builds separate GPU textures for discrete labels and continuous weights, using point and bilinear filtering to support weighted raymarching in Unity volume rendering.
